primary.root_cause: A continuous assignment creates a combinatorial feedback loop that retains the previous read value when the address does not match ADDR_IN_DATA, overriding the sequential read logic and preventing correct register reads after reset.
evidence: FAIL: Data Output Register not reset. Expected: 0x00000000, Got: 0x0000003C
primary.proposed_fix: Remove the continuous assignment and handle the ADDR_IN_DATA case directly inside the existing always_ff read block. Ensure prdata_d is driven in every valid read cycle and properly initialized to zero.

alternative.root_cause: The interrupt state register is implemented as a set-only flip-flop that accumulates interrupt flags across test cases instead of reflecting only the current input state, violating the read-only status specification.
alternative.proposed_fix: Replace the set-only update with a direct assignment that reflects the current interrupt condition, or add a clear mechanism triggered on read to ensure the register does not retain stale flags across test iterations.
